review_comments.body: The `all(...)` guard establishes that every document has a `content` key at runtime, but mypy still sees each `doc` in this comprehension as `dict[str, Any] | str`. The repository type check fails on `doc["content"]` with `Invalid index type "str" for "str"`. Please restore the per-item `isinstance(doc, dict)` guard here so the existing default path continues to type-check.

comments.body:
Thanks @vishal-bala, restored the per-document `isinstance(doc, dict)` check in `voyageai.py`, so mixed lists of dicts and strings are handled per item. The new tests pass (4/4) and mypy is clean on the file.
